body: Sloan (1996, The Accounting Review) showed the accrual component of earnings is less persistent than the cash component and that the market overprices high-accrual firms; a long-low/short-high accrual decile hedge earned ~10%/yr in 1962-91 (anomaly weaker post-publication). Cash-flow version: accruals = (PAT - CFO) / average total assets. Thresholds (practitioner): < -5% conservative; > +10% high-accrual flag; > 20% extreme. Readings: SMCI FY2024 +53.9% and FY2026 +41.1% (SEC XBRL); PC Jeweller FY19 +23.2%; Gensol FY24 +8.9%; Infosys FY2025 -7.0%; Asian Paints FY26 -8.3% (Screener). Not for banks/NBFCs. Use the trend and pair with DSO/DIO to find which accrual is growing; it is the same signal as Beneish's TATA term (weight 4.679).
title: Sloan accruals ratio: (PAT - CFO) / average assets, with real readings
